entities.name: PMID:27494853
observations: Primary study reports MET promotes Sei-1-induced double-minute chromosome formation in NIH-3T3 murine fibroblasts; MET inhibition reduced double-minute counts and amplification of genes carried on them.

entities.name: MET
observations: Reported to be amplified and overexpressed in the Sei-1-overexpressing NIH-3T3 model; MET inhibition reduced double-minute chromosome numbers.

entities.name: Sei-1
observations: Overexpression was used to induce double-minute chromosomes in NIH-3T3 murine fibroblasts.

entities.name: MET promotes DMs
observations: In Sei-1-overexpressing NIH-3T3 murine fibroblasts, MET inhibition reduced double-minute chromosome numbers and amplification of DM-carried genes, supporting that MET promotes DM formation.
